inShort: A hits topspin balls (aka rolls) at B's feet in the transition zone, and B resets every one back into the kitchen.
rules: A stands at the kitchen line, B halfway between the baseline and the kitchen.
A hits every ball with topspin at B's feet, at about half pace, like a fourth shot in a game.
B resets every ball soft back into the kitchen.
Stay low, paddle in front, and let the ball come to you.
Count the resets in a row that land in the kitchen.
tooEasy: A raises the pace and varies the target: body, backhand, forehand. Even harder: A aims only at B's backhand.
tooHard: A plays slower and straight at B's paddle.
goodLooksLike: The resets land low in the kitchen, so A has to dink them instead of rolling again, even when A's ball comes fast.
